"Mark as accepted" and "Mark as declined" record the patient's reply. Declining opens a small browser window for you to note the reason, if you want. Os dois botões: Aprovar e Ignorar: The two buttons: Approve and Ignore
Below each suggestion there are two buttons. "Approve" means the team agrees with that step. "Ignore" means the team does not want to go that way. Both record the decision, with your name and the time, and remove the suggestion from this tab. Neither one sends a message to the customer, creates a task or moves the deal to another stage.
Atendentes, gerentes e administradores p: Support staff, managers and administrators can decide. People with the "Read-only" role see the list, but the buttons are disabled.
A aba \"Já decididas\" mostra as últimas: The "Already decided" tab shows the last 50 decisions, from newest to oldest. Each row says whether the suggestion was "Approved" or "Ignored", which deal it was for, who decided and when. Below comes the text the AI had suggested. Ignoring also gets its own label, just like approving: declining is also a decision, and it is recorded.
Decidir sobre as sugestões da IA e confe: Decide on the AI's suggestions and check where the decision is recorded.
Antes de clicar, leia a sugestão e veja: Before clicking, read the suggestion and check which deal it is for. Here the AI suggests sending Henrique, early tomorrow, the reminder for Thursday's physiotherapy with the clinic's address. It is a step that makes sense. Click "Approve".
Se a IA trocar a sugestão enquanto a tel: If the AI changes the suggestion while the screen is open, the click does not count: the notice "The proposal changed since you read it. Check the new one before deciding." appears and the list updates with the new suggestion.

Approving did not send anything to the customer: it recorded that the team agrees with this step. When the AI serves this customer again, it receives this decision along with the rest of the conversation.
Aprovar não faz o passo acontecer sozinh: Approving does not make the step happen on its own. If it depends on someone on the team, such as a phone call, create a task in "Tasks" so you don't forget.

The suggestion leaves the list just the same, and the refusal is recorded. When the AI serves Patrícia again, it learns that the team declined this suggestion.

quanto custa a busca: how much does the search cost
Na instalação padrão, as empresas vêm da: In the standard installation, companies come from Apify, an outside service that searches for businesses on Google Maps and charges each search to your balance there. That is why Prospecting needs your Apify account key. The first time, with no key saved, the setup boxes already appear open and the "Search for companies" button is grayed out. After that, they are behind the "Set up search" button.
Em \"Chave da Apify\", cole o token da A: In "Apify key", paste the API token, which you find in your Apify account settings, and click "Save key". Before saving, the system checks the key with Apify: if it is not accepted, nothing is saved and a notice appears. Once accepted, it is stored encrypted on the server, the boxes close and "Search key saved." appears. The saved key is not shown again; to change it, paste the new one and save again.
O campo mostra só pontinhos enquanto voc: The field shows only dots while you type, so the key does not appear on the screen.
No quadro \"Voz e vocabulário\", preench: In the "Voice and vocabulary" box, fill in "Your name", "What you do" and "Differentiator": the AI writes the first message in that person's voice. In "Vocabulary by niche", write one line per segment in the format "term: value". When the search segment contains the term, the outreach strategy uses its value to talk about what that type of company wants to gain. Click "Save personalization": it applies to all campaigns.
No quadro \"1. Encontrar empresas\", esc: In the "1. Find companies" box, write the type of company in "Audience or segment" and where it is in "City or region", the way you would search on Google Maps. "Up to how many companies" is the maximum the search returns, from 1 to 100. "Search cap (US$)" is the most this search can spend from your Apify balance, from US$ 0.50 to US$ 10.

"Enrich with business emails and social networks found on the website" asks the search for the contacts published on each company's website. "Automatically assess each company's website" makes the system open each website and note what it found, without using AI. "Automatically generate the message preview" makes the AI write a draft of the first message for each checked company and uses AI credit; it only works with the website assessment turned on. Click "Search for companies".
Nenhuma mensagem sai nesta etapa. A busc: No message goes out at this step. escolher quem abordar: choose who to reach out to
Com a busca concluída, a campanha fica e: With the search completed, the campaign is in "Prepare campaign" and each company appears as "Found". In the "Audit" column, the "Score" adds up three signals: the Google rating, the number of reviews and the state of the website; next to it is what weighed most, such as "high rating + website with problems". Below appear the website summary, such as "Website with problems", "No website of its own" or "Website in order", and the start of the preview: the draft of the first message the AI prepared. In "Sort", choose "Score" to see the companies with the most points first.
O Score foi pensado para quem vende site: The Score was designed for those who sell websites or automation. With the "Professional website" offer, a company with no website or a poor one gets more points than a company whose website is in order. If your offer is something else, use the Score only as a hint.
Clique em \"Ver detalhes\" para abrir a: Click "View details" to open the company's "Website audit": the problems found, what the website already has, what is missing and a suggested outreach strategy, with common objections and answers, designed for those who sell websites or automation. "Reanalyze website" opens the website again right away; after that, the old preview is no longer valid. "Outreach preview" asks the AI for a new preview, which is saved in place of the previous one and uses AI credit. To close, click the X in the top corner of the window or outside it.
Deixe de fora quem não abordar: Leave out those you won't reach out to
Na coluna \"Abordar\", todas as empresas: In the "Reach out" column, all companies come checked, and only the checked ones enter the queue when you start the outreach. To leave one out, uncheck its box. Here the clinic removes "Castro Lima Advogados Associados", which has only 6 reviews.
A empresa desmarcada sai da lista na hor: The unchecked company leaves the list right away, and the "Show unchecked" button now counts 2. Click it to see who was left out; checking the box again brings the company back. "Check all" and "Uncheck all" change the whole list at once. "Delete unchecked" removes these companies from the campaign after asking for confirmation; in a future search, they may appear again.

Atenção: com a opção de parar \"Na prime: Note: with the stop-receiving option set to "In the first message (recommended)", the suggested strategy, which talks about websites or automation, also goes to the AI to write the first message. Entender o que são provedor e modelo, ac: Understand what a provider and a model are, find the screen and read what it shows: the default model and the tasks grouped by what they do.
qual ia o sistema usa: which ai does the system use
Provedores fica no hub de IA: Providers is in the AI hub
Provedores não aparece direto no menu la: Providers does not appear directly in the side menu. In the menu's "AI agent" group, click "See everything in AI". The "Providers" card is in the "Set up the agent" section. The full path is: AI agent › See everything in AI › Providers.
Provedor é a empresa que fornece a intel: A provider is the company that supplies the artificial intelligence (AI), such as Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT) or Google (Gemini). A model is the version chosen within that company, such as "Claude Sonnet 5". The system uses AI in many tasks: replying to the customer, gauging the mood of the conversation, reading images, searching your material and others. The sentence below the title says in how many places. This screen shows which model does each task and lets you change it.
Enquanto a empresa não tiver nenhuma cha: While the company has no key registered in "Credentials" for the AI that does the talking, a yellow notice with the "Register a key" link appears below the title. Managers can also open this screen, but only for reference: saving the default model, saving the choice for a task, turning on Jev and saving the Maps key are up to the administrator.
O cartão \"Modelo padrão\" mostra o prov: The "Default model" card shows the provider and model the company uses when no one has chosen another. It applies to the tasks that show "Using the organization's default.", and the card's sentence counts how many are like that today. The exception is tasks with the "fixed" badge, which the system handles on its own. The sentence at the end of the card mentions the audio ones and the ones that search your material.
Mais abaixo, as tarefas aparecem em seis: Further down, the tasks appear in six groups, by what they do: "Serve the customer", "Improve and test", "Understand the conversation", "Protect the operation", "Remember and search" and "See and hear". Each group has a sentence explaining what it does and, under "Using:", the models its tasks use today. If any task in the group needs attention, a yellow notice appears. The "Advanced settings" button opens the group's tasks one by one. The screen calls each task a "point".
Escolher outro provedor ou modelo para t: Choose another provider or model for all tasks that follow the default, at once.
No cartão \"Modelo padrão\", clique em \: On the "Default model" card, click "Provider" to see the AI companies the system can work with. Before switching companies, check that it has a key registered in "Credentials" (or in the system's installation): this screen does not do that check. When you switch providers, the "Model" field becomes empty, waiting for your choice.
Se a lista de modelos dessa empresa aind: If the system has not yet downloaded that company's model list, the "Model" field turns into a box where you type the model's name the way the AI company writes it.
Em \"Modelo\", escolha a versão. Aqui, a: In "Model", choose the version. Here, the example clinic chose "Claude Haiku 5.5", from the same company. The "Save default" button only appears for administrators and only lights up after you change something. When you save, the new model applies at once to all tasks that follow the default.
Quem não segue o padrão: What does not follow the default
Nem toda tarefa acompanha o modelo padrã: Not every task follows the default model. With a published agent, the agent's own tasks use the model chosen in it, and several support tasks, such as "Summarize the long conversation", inherit that model: their card says "Inherited from whoever triggered the call". Tasks with the "fixed" badge are handled by the system on its own, such as the audio ones and the ones that search your material, which the sentence at the end of the card lists. And a task you configure individually, as the next lesson shows, keeps your choice.
Escolher o modelo de uma tarefa: Choose the model for a task
Abrir as tarefas de um grupo, ler o cart: Open a group's tasks, read each one's card and change the model for a single task.
Cada grupo esconde as suas tarefas até v: Each group hides its tasks until you ask. To see them one by one, click "Advanced settings" in the group; to close, the same button turns into "Hide". The number in parentheses says how many tasks ("points") the group has. In this example, we open the "See and hear" group, which handles the images and audio the customer sends. In "Using:", "not set" means that a task in the group has no model: here, the audio one.
Cada tarefa tem um cartão. No alto ficam: Each task has a card. At the top are its name and what it does. On the right, the model in use and why: "Using the organization's default." means it follows the Default model. The "If it fails:" strip tells what you will notice day to day if this task stops working. Some tasks have the "needs tools" badge: only a model that can use the CRM's tools works for them. In the model list, those that cannot appear with "no tools", and the system rejects them when you save.
Outras explicações que aparecem à direit: Other explanations that appear on the right: "Chosen by you in the providers panel."; "Set in the agent's published version."; "Inherited from whoever triggered the call", when the task uses the model of the agent that called it; and "Most economical model from the same provider", in short classifications, which do not need the agent's model.
Tarefas com o selo \"fixo\" não têm esco: Tasks with the "fixed" badge have no choice on this screen: the system decides on its own, and the text at the end of the card explains why. For them, that text is what counts, even when the right-hand column says "Using the organization's default.". This is the case for "Listen to the customer's audio". Audio becomes text through the installation's transcription service, through an OpenAI key or through the conversation model itself, when it understands audio. On the right, the card says which of these routes is in effect or, as in this clinic, what is missing.
Nas tarefas que dá para trocar, o cartão: In the tasks that can be changed, the card has three fields. In "Provider", the AI company. In "Model", the version: here we chose "Claude Haiku 5.5". In "Key", you can pin one of that provider's keys registered in "Credentials"; leaving it on "from the installation", no key is pinned for this task. Then click "Save". If the model does not suit the task, the system rejects it or warns you, in a message that explains why.
Com um provedor compatível com a OpenAI,: With an OpenAI-compatible provider, such as "Custom provider", the "Own address (optional)" field also appears, to point the task to another address. If left blank, the provider's official address applies.
Pronto: à direita aparece o modelo novo,: Done: the new model appears on the right, by its technical name, and the explanation changes to "Chosen by you in the providers panel.". From now on, this task keeps your choice, even if the Default model changes later. The screen has no button to go back to following the default: to change again, choose another model and click "Save".
No grupo \"Atender o cliente\", as três: In the "Serve the customer" group, the agent's own three tasks ("Test or review reply", "Reply to the customer" and "Work the pipeline") have no fields here when there is a published agent. They use the model chosen in the agent itself, in the published version. The card says so and has the "Set up in the agent" link, which opens the Agents screen. While no agent is published, these cards show the fields like the others.
Entender o que são o Jev e o cartão de M: Understand what Jev and the Maps card are, and how to turn each one on.
O Jev é uma IA à parte, da empresa TypeS: Jev is a separate AI, from the company TypeSafe AI. It does not talk with the customer: it makes quick, cheap decisions, such as noticing whether the customer is annoyed, and works together with your main AI. The badge in the corner shows its status; in this clinic, "Off". If you work in healthcare, read the card's notice: the messages Jev reads may contain health data, which the LGPD treats as sensitive. Before turning it on, check with whoever handles the company's LGPD compliance whether TypeSafe's contract covers this type of data.
Em \"De onde o Jev responde\", escolha p: In "Where Jev answers from", choose how it works: "TypeSafe AI (own key)", with a key just for it, or "OpenRouter (reuses the OpenRouter credential)", which uses the OpenRouter key the company has already registered in "Credentials". Switching to OpenRouter is only accepted if that key has already passed the test. With TypeSafe, click "Get the key from TypeSafe" to open their website: there you create an account and add credit, because each message Jev evaluates is charged by TypeSafe. Then click "Paste the key".
Só o administrador escolhe a origem, col: Only administrators choose the source, paste the key and turn on Jev. Managers see the card, but instead of "Paste the key", they read that only whoever administers the company can do that.
Colar a chave e ligar: Paste the key and turn on
Abre a janela \"Adicionar credencial\",: The "Add credential" window opens, already set to the "Jev (TypeSafe AI)" provider. Paste the key in "Key" and click "Save and validate". The system stores the key encrypted and runs a test with TypeSafe. When the key passes, the card shows "Key verified with TypeSafe" and starts displaying what Jev will do, the box to agree to the messages being sent to the United States (only the first time) and the "Turn on Jev" button. If the key does not pass, the card explains why and offers "Test again".
Mapas: a rua no lugar das coordenadas: Maps: the street instead of the coordinates
O cartão \"Mapas (Google)\" é outro extr: The "Maps (Google)" card is another extra. When the customer sends their location via WhatsApp, the system queries Google and the agent reads the approximate street and city, instead of just the coordinates. Without a key, nothing changes, and the badge shows "No key". To turn it on, create a key in Google Cloud with the Geocoding API enabled, paste it into "Geocoding API key" and click "Save key". "Test" runs a real query to Google and shows the address that came back or the reason for the failure. With the field empty and no key saved, both buttons are disabled.
Gravar e testar a chave de Mapas é só do: Only administrators can save and test the Maps key. Once saved, the key never comes back in full: the badge shows only the last four characters, and the "Remove key" button appears.
Quando um mesmo número de WhatsApp tem m: When the same WhatsApp number has more than one AI agent, the router reads what the customer wants and hands the conversation to the right agent.
Conhecendo a tela de Roteadores: Getting to know the Routers screen
Entender o que um roteador faz, onde fic: Understand what a router does, where the screen is and what each router's card and page show.
mais de um agente no mesmo número: more than one agent on the same number
direcionar conversa para o agente certo: send conversation to the right agent
Roteadores não aparece direto no menu la: Routers does not appear directly in the side menu. In the menu's "AI agent" group, click "See everything in AI". The "Routers" card is in the "Set up the agent" section. The full path is: AI agent › See everything in AI › Routers.
Só gerente ou administrador vê este cart: Only managers or administrators see this card. For support staff, or for someone with read-only access, it does not appear, and the screen's address leads to the "403 — Permission denied" page.
Um agente de IA é o atendente virtual qu: An AI agent is the virtual assistant that replies to customers on WhatsApp. When the company has more than one agent, each handling one topic, the router decides who answers. It reads the customer's message, understands what the person wants (the "intent") and hands the conversation to the agent for that topic. Each router is linked to one WhatsApp number. Here you see the router that Clínica Bem Viver is setting up for the reception number.
Cada cartão é um roteador. No alto vêm o: Each card is a router. At the top are the name and the "active" or "inactive" badge. Active means it already decides who answers the number's conversations. Inactive means it decides nothing: the number keeps being answered as if the router did not exist. Below are the WhatsApp number and how many intents it has. This one is still "inactive" and has "No intents configured": the clinic will set everything up before turning it on.
Um número pode ter vários roteadores gua: A number can have several saved routers, but only one active at a time.
Click the card to open the router. "Identification" holds the name, the number and the on/off switch. In "Intents", on the right, you say which topics it recognizes and which agent handles each one. Further down, on the left, are the AI model that reads the messages, the backup agent for when no intent fits, and a test. Nothing you change takes effect until you click "Save".
Um gerente também abre os roteadores, ma: A manager can also open routers, but only to view and test them: the fields are locked and the "New router", "Intent", "Save" and "Delete router" buttons do not appear. Only an administrator creates, changes and deletes routers.
Criar um roteador novo e ligá-lo a um nú: Create a new router and link it to one of the company's WhatsApp numbers.
este número já tem um roteador ativo: this number already has an active router
Para criar um roteador, clique em \"Novo: To create a router, click "New router" at the top of the screen. When the company does not have any yet, the screen shows an explanation in the middle and the "Create my first router" button, which opens the same window.
Na janela \"Novo roteador\", dê um nome: In the "New router" window, give it a name that says what it is for. In "WhatsApp number", you choose the number it will handle: the list shows the company's WhatsApp numbers, each with its status. Notice the warning below: you can only have one active router per number.
Clique no número que o roteador vai aten: Click the number the router will handle. Here you see "Recepção Bem Viver", with the status "Connected". Choose carefully: once the router is created, its number cannot be changed. For another number, create another router.
Com o nome e o número escolhidos, o botã: With the name and number chosen, the "Create router" button becomes active. The new router starts out active. So if the chosen number already has another active router, the system refuses and warns: "This number already has an active router.". In that case, turn the other one off first. To give up, click "Cancel".
Depois de criado, a página do roteador a: Once created, the router's page opens on its own, with the notice "Router created — now choose the intents.". It already shows as "active", but it has no intents or backup agent yet. The intents panel says that, without a backup agent, the conversation would get no automatic reply, but that is not what happens: while the router is empty, the number keeps being answered as it was before the router existed. The next step is to add the intents, in the next lesson.
Ensinar ao roteador cada assunto que os: Teach the router each topic customers bring up and say which agent handles each one.
roteador não reconhece o assunto: router does not recognize the topic
Uma intenção é um assunto que faz o clie: An intent is a topic that makes the customer write in, such as "book an appointment" or "test results". The router compares each message with the intents you added and picks the best match. This router does not have any yet. To add the first one, click "Intent", with the plus sign.
Em \"Nome da intenção\", escreva um nome: In "Intent name", write a short name, such as "Book appointment". Two topics in the same router cannot have the same name. In "Agent that handles it", choose who takes over the conversation when the customer wants this. In this example clinic there is only Bia. In an operation with several agents, each intent points to the agent who knows that topic. Notice the red warning below the block: the description is still missing, so "Save" is disabled.
O agente escolhido aqui não precisa de n: The agent chosen here does not need its own number. After you save, its screen shows the notice "This agent is triggered by the router" and, without its own number, it can be published using the router's number.
Em \"Quando escolher esta intenção\", de: In "When to choose this intent", describe the situation in your own words, as you would explain it to a new staff member. The AI reads this description, together with the name and the example phrases, to decide. Name, agent and description are required. With all three filled in, the red warning disappears and "Save" becomes active.
Em \"Frases de exemplo (opcional)\", esc: In "Example phrases (optional)", write messages the way a patient would and press Enter, or click "Add". Each phrase becomes a tag; clicking a tag removes the phrase. Each intent holds up to 10 phrases. The examples help the AI recognize the topic even when the customer writes it differently.
\"Funil de destino (opcional)\" serve pa: "Destination pipeline (optional)" is for companies with a sales pipeline for each service. If you leave "No destination — just choose the agent", the router only chooses who answers. If you choose a pipeline, when this intent is recognized and the customer has an open deal, the system moves that deal to the chosen pipeline before the agent replies. Then the "Destination stage" field also appears, already set to "First open stage".
Se quem administra o servidor ligou o mó: If the server administrator has enabled the "Support flows" module (in Admin, under "Optional features"), each intent also gets the "Support flow (optional)" field: a script of questions that starts when the intent is recognized.
Para outro assunto, clique de novo em \": For another topic, click "Intent" again: each one gets its own block, and the trash icon next to the agent removes the block. When you finish, click "Save" and the notice "Router saved." appears. The intents only start deciding who answers when the router is active.
Reserva, teste e ligar o roteador: Backup, testing and turning the router on
Escolher o agente de reserva, entender o: Choose the backup agent, understand the model that reads the messages, and test, turn on, turn off or delete the router.
Nem toda mensagem combina com uma intenç: Not every message matches an intent, and the AI can also be unsure: below 60% certainty, the default minimum, its choice does not count. For these cases there is the "Fallback agent", the backup agent: when the conversation is not yet with the agent of some intent, it answers whatever was not recognized. Here it is Bia. If you choose "None — respond with the default support", the reply comes from whoever would reply if the router did not exist: usually, the agent published on the number.
Se a IA que lê as mensagens falhar, por: If the AI that reads the messages fails, for example because the provider account has run out of credit, the conversation stays with the agent of the intent that was already handling it; if it was not with any agent yet, it goes to the backup agent.
A IA que lê as mensagens: The AI that reads the messages
Em \"Modelo que identifica a intenção\": "Model that identifies the intent" holds the AI that reads each message and chooses the intent. "Automatic — uses the organization's provider" lets the system use the AI the company has already set up. To choose another model, only those from providers with a registered key, in the company or the installation, appear. While there is no usable AI key, the field stays locked on "Automatic" and the notice below asks you to register one in Credentials (AI agent › See everything in AI › Credentials). In "Previous messages for routing", from 0 to 16, you set how many earlier messages in the conversation the AI reads along with the current one: more messages help it understand the context, but can increase cost and delay.
Quanto da conversa ela lê: How much of the conversation it reads
\"Testar classificação\" mostra o que o: "Test classification" shows what the router would do with a phrase of yours, without touching any real conversation. You write the way a customer would and click the button. You see the chosen intent, the AI's certainty as a percentage and the agent that would answer. If the certainty is below the minimum, the result warns that, for real, the conversation would not follow that intent. The test uses the router as it is saved and only works when it is active; that is why the notice "Turn on the router to test the classification." appears here. Once active, the router already decides the number's conversations: test right after turning it on and saving. Each test uses the real AI and spends provider credit.
O gerente, que só pode ver a tela, també: A manager, who can only view the screen, can also use the test.
Com as intenções prontas e salvas, cliqu: With the intents ready and saved, click the switch in the "Identification" block. The text beside it changes right away to "Active — routing this number's conversations", but nothing has changed yet: the badge at the top stays "inactive" until you click "Save". After you save, for each new message the AI is going to answer on that number, the router chooses the agent. When it hands a conversation to an agent, the conversation stays with that agent; it only changes if the customer starts talking about another topic you added, with enough certainty. To turn it off, click the switch again and save: the number goes back to being answered as it was before the router.
Se outro roteador já estiver ativo no me: If another router is already active on the same number, the system refuses when you save, with the notice "This number already has an active router.". Turn the other one off first.
\"Excluir roteador\", no canto de cima,: "Delete router", in the top corner, deletes the router and all its intents. First, a window asks for confirmation. After deleting, you go back to the list, and the number is answered as it was before the router. This cannot be undone. If you only want to stop the router for a while, turn off the switch and save instead of deleting.
Manuais curtos de como agir em situações: Short manuals on how to act in specific situations, which the AI agent checks when the subject comes up in the conversation: install from the catalog, edit and keep up to date.
Conhecendo a tela de Skills: Getting to know the Skills screen
Entender o que é uma skill, quando o age: Understand what a skill is, when the agent uses one and what each part of the screen shows.
No menu lateral padrão, Skills não apare: Skills does not appear in the default side menu. In the menu's "AI agent" group, click "See everything in AI". The "Skills" card is in the "Teach the agent" section. The full path is: AI agent › See everything in AI › Skills.
Uma skill é um manual curto de como agir: A skill is a short manual on how to act in a specific situation, such as booking an appointment or explaining how to prepare for the first consultation. The AI agent always knows the skill exists, from its name and description. The full step-by-step enters the conversation when the subject comes up: when the customer writes one of the skill's keywords, or when the conversation or the contact has a chosen tag. That way the agent does not need to load every manual in every reply. The screen has two parts: "Installed skills", the ones your company installed or uploaded, and "Catalog", the platform's ready-made ones.
Uma skill vale para todos os agentes de: A skill applies to all of the company's AI agents. This screen has no way to turn on a skill for just one agent. If the installation has the "Support flows" module turned on, a flow step can also pull in an installed skill, even without a keyword.
Cada skill instalada mostra o nome, um s: Each installed skill shows its name, a source badge and, on the right, the date of the last change, in "updated on". The "manual" badge means your team uploaded the skill in a .zip file. The "from the catalog" badge means it was installed from the Catalog. Below comes the description, the sentence the agent reads to know what the skill is for. "Edit" opens the skill's text and "Uninstall" removes your company's copy.
Enviar uma skill da sua equipe: Upload a skill from your team
\"Enviar skill (.zip)\" instala uma skil: "Upload skill (.zip)" installs a skill written by your team. The .zip file must have, at its root, a file named SKILL.md, with the name, the description and the keywords at the top and the step-by-step right below. It can also include the "references" and "assets" folders, with supporting material. If you upload a .zip with the name of a skill that already exists, your version takes its place.
O pacote aceita até 64 arquivos e 5 MB d: The package accepts up to 64 files and 5 MB once unzipped. The step-by-step can have at most 200 lines. The skill name cannot have accents or ç.
No \"Catálogo\" ficam as skills prontas: "Catalog" holds the ready-made skills that the platform maintains and that your company has not installed yet. Here, the one left is "objecao-preco", which teaches the agent how to handle a customer who thinks it is too expensive, without giving a discount that was not authorized. Note: even without installing it, a catalog skill already applies to your agents. "Install" creates a copy for your company, which you can edit.
Instalar e desinstalar uma skill do catá: Install and uninstall a catalog skill
Instalar uma skill pronta da plataforma: Install a ready-made platform skill and learn what happens when it is uninstalled.
Para instalar uma skill do catálogo, cli: To install a catalog skill, click "Install" on its row. Let's install "objecao-preco".
A skill passou para Skills instaladas: The skill moved to Installed skills
Pronto: a \"objecao-preco\" entrou em \": Done: "objecao-preco" is now in "Installed skills", with the "from the catalog" badge, and a confirmation message appears for a few seconds. "Catalog" is now empty, because your company has already installed everything the platform offers today. The copy belongs to your company: you can edit it without touching the catalog.
\"Desinstalar\" tira de uso na hora a có: "Uninstall" immediately takes your company's copy out of use, without asking for confirmation. For a "from the catalog" skill, like this one, the platform version applies to the agents again, as before installing. For a "manual" skill, the agent stops using it, unless it has the same name as a catalog skill: then the catalog one applies again.
As versões da cópia não são apagadas: se: The copy's versions are not deleted: if you install the same skill again, they appear again in "Version history", under "Edit".
A \"objecao-preco\" saiu de \"Skills ins: "objecao-preco" left "Installed skills" and went back to "Catalog", with the "Install" button. The agents keep using the platform version.
Mudar quando uma skill entra na conversa: Change when a skill enters the conversation and what it tells the agent to do, without losing the previous version.
Vamos ajustar a \"preparo-primeira-consu: Let's adjust "preparo-primeira-consulta", which the clinic wrote to guide people coming for the first time. Click "Edit" on its row.
A janela \"Editar skill\" mostra a skill: The "Edit skill" window shows the skill in parts. "Description" is the short sentence the agent always reads, to know the skill exists and what it is for; it takes up a single line, with up to 500 characters. "Activation keywords" are the words that make the step-by-step enter the conversation: one of them just needs to appear in the customer's most recent messages. Capital letters and accents make no difference. Separate the words with commas; you need at least one.
Acrescentar uma palavra e usar etiquetas: Add a word and use tags
Os pacientes perguntam muito se precisam: Patients often ask whether they need to fast. The step-by-step already answers this, but the word "fasting" was not on the list: we added it at the end, after a comma. "Tags that activate it" is optional: if the conversation or the contact has one of these tags, the skill kicks in even without any keyword. Here, anyone with the "primeira-consulta" tag gets these preparation instructions even if they only say "hi". Write the tag exactly as it is used in conversations and contacts: it must be the same word, part of it is not enough.
\"Corpo\" é o passo a passo que o agente: "Body" is the step-by-step the agent follows when the skill enters the conversation. It fits in up to 200 lines: the counter next to it shows how many have been used and turns red when it goes over the limit, and then the "Save" button is disabled. Below, "Version history" lists each saved version, with date and time; "in use" marks the one that applies now.
Clique em \"Salvar\". Salvar não apaga n: Click "Save". Saving does not delete anything: it creates a new version, and the previous one is kept in the history. "Cancel" closes the window without saving.
A janela fecha e aparece por alguns segu: The window closes and a message appears for a few seconds saying the skill was updated and already applies to the agents. When you open "Edit" again, the word "fasting" is on the list and "Version history" has two lines: the new version, "in use", and the previous one. If the change did not turn out well, click "Restore" next to the previous version: it applies again right away, without needing to save.
Adotar a versão nova de uma skill do cat: Adopt the new version of a catalog skill
Entender o aviso de versão nova, conferi: Understand the new version notice, check what changes and decide whether to adopt it.
A clínica instalou a \"agendamento\" do: The clinic installed "agendamento" from the catalog two months ago and then added two keywords. Since then, the platform has published a new version of this skill. That is why its row got this notice. Your company's copy does not change on its own: it keeps applying until you decide.
O que muda se você adotar: What changes if you adopt it
O aviso resume o que muda se você adotar: The notice summarizes what changes if you adopt the catalog version: here, the "Description", the "Activation keywords" and the "Procedure (body)", with how many lines come in (+) and how many go out (−). Keywords that come in appear with the + sign; those that go out are in red, with the − sign. Here, "assessment" and "walk-in" go out: the clinic added these words, and they do not exist in the catalog version.
Se quiser a versão nova, clique em \"Ado: If you want the new version, click "Adopt new version". The catalog version starts to apply, and what the clinic edited goes out of use, but stays saved in "Version history". So as not to lose the clinic's words, you can add them again later, in "Edit".
O aviso sumiu, a descrição já é a da ver: The notice is gone, the description is already the new version's, and the date in "updated on" is now the current one. A confirmation message also appears for a few seconds. The badge is still "from the catalog": when the platform publishes another version, the notice comes back.
Em \"Editar\", o \"Histórico de versões\: In "Edit", "Version history" now has three lines: the version you just adopted, "in use", the one the clinic edited and the first installed copy. To go back to the clinic's keywords, click "Restore" next to the edited version. When you go back to it, the new version notice appears again.
Quanto a inteligência artificial gastou: How much the artificial intelligence spent and worked in the month, and the spending limit that alerts you or makes the AI stop.
Conhecendo a tela de Uso e orçamento: Getting to know the Usage and budget screen
Achar a tela e entender o que o orçament: Find the screen and understand what the month's budget, the numbers and the charts show.
Uso e orçamento não aparece direto no me: Usage and budget does not appear directly in the side menu. In the menu's "AI agent" group, click "See everything in AI". The "Usage and budget" card is in the "Monitor the agent" section. The full path is: AI agent › See everything in AI › Usage and budget.
The screen opens with the title "AI usage". It answers two questions: how much the artificial intelligence (AI) cost and how much it worked. The one who charges is the provider, the company that owns the AI (such as Anthropic): each time the system calls the AI, the price depends on how much text it reads and writes. At the top is the "Monthly AI budget" card. Below it come the filters, the numbers for the period and the charts.
Os valores aparecem em dólar (US$), a mo: Amounts appear in dollars (US$), the currency the AI provider bills in. The screen does not convert them to reais.
O cartão \"Orçamento mensal de IA\" soma: The "Monthly AI budget" card adds up what the AI spent in the current month, from the 1st until now. It does not change with the filters below. The bar shows how much of the month's limit has already been used. With no limit, as here, the bar stays empty and the card says "No limit set — the AI won't stop on its own due to spend." With a limit, the limit amount appears next to the spending, along with the percentage already used. The bar turns yellow when spending reaches the alert point and red when it reaches the limit.
Só o administrador vê o botão \"Editar l: Only administrators see the "Edit limit" button. Managers see the card but cannot change the limit.
Quanto do limite já foi: How much of the limit is used
\"Custo no período\" é quanto a IA custo: "Cost in the period" is how much the AI cost in the period set by the filters; with no dates chosen, in the last 30 days. "AI calls" counts each time the system called the AI. One agent reply can make several calls, and the system also calls the AI for other tasks, such as choosing which agent handles a conversation or gauging the mood of the conversation. "Agent turns" counts the times the agent stepped into the conversation to reply to a customer; below it is the average cost of each turn.
A observação \"conta só os turnos que a: The note "counts only the turns the queue still keeps" means that old turns, which the system has already deleted from the work queue, are left out of this count.
Parte do texto que o sistema manda para: Part of the text the system sends to the AI repeats from one call to the next, such as the agent's instructions. The provider keeps that text in a "cache" and charges much less for it. "Cache rate" shows how much of the text sent came from that cache. "Passed to a person" compares the handovers of conversations from the AI to someone on the team with the messages customers sent in the period: the higher it is, the more the AI needed help. "Time for one AI call" shows the common worst case: in 95 out of every 100 calls, the AI replied in that time or less. Below it, "most respond in" gives the typical time.
Esse tempo é o de uma chamada só, e não: This time is for a single call, not the time the customer waited: one reply may need several calls. And note: today "Passed to a person" leaves out the handovers the agent itself makes in the middle of a conversation, for example when the customer asks to talk to a person. That is why the number may come out lower than the real one.
Texto que veio do cache: Text that came from the cache
Mais abaixo, quatro gráficos mostram o m: Further down, four charts show the same period day by day. "How much was spent per day (US$)" is the cost of each day. "Text volume processed per day" is how much text the AI read and wrote, counted in tokens, the little pieces of words the provider charges for. "Time for one AI call per day (seconds)" has two lines: the typical time and the common worst case. "How much went to a person (%)" shows the handovers to the team on each day. Hover over a chart to see the value for each day.
Um gráfico sem nada no período mostra \": A chart with nothing in the period shows "No data for this period".
Definir um limite de gasto com aviso: Set a spending limit with an alert
Escolher o limite de gasto do mês e rece: Choose the month's spending limit and get an alert before reaching it, without stopping the AI.
Para definir um limite de gasto, clique: To set a spending limit, click "Edit limit", in the corner of the "Monthly AI budget" card.
A janela \"Orçamento de IA\" pergunta o: The "AI budget" window asks what happens when the month's spending reaches the limit. "Just monitor" is the default: the AI never stops because of spending, and you just keep an eye on the number. "Notify me when it passes…" opens a notice in the Notification Center when spending reaches the chosen point, and the AI keeps replying. "Stop the AI when it reaches…" makes the AI stop replying when spending reaches the limit. Notice that this last one starts disabled: it only becomes available after "Notify me" has been saved.
O limite e o ponto do aviso: The limit and the alert point
Marque \"Me avisar\" e escreva o limite: Select "Notify me" and type the month's limit in "Monthly limit (US$)", in dollars. Here we use 20. The option's title already shows what was agreed: "Notify me when it passes 80% of US$ 20.00". With the alert selected, the "Notify when it reaches (% of the limit)" field appears: it is the alert point, between 50% and 99% of the limit. By default, it comes with 80.
Para avisar ou parar, o limite precisa s: To alert or stop, the limit must be at least US$ 1.00 per month. Below that, the "Save" button is blocked and the window explains why.
Clique em \"Salvar\". \"Cancelar\" fecha: Click "Save". "Cancel" closes the window without changing anything.
A janela fecha e aparece, por alguns seg: The window closes and the message "Budget updated" appears for a few seconds. The card now shows the spending next to the limit ("spent of US$ 20.00"), the percentage already used and what was agreed: "We notify when it passes 80% of the limit. The AI doesn't stop." When the month's spending reaches that point, the system opens a notice in the Notification Center, the "Alerts" screen in the AI hub. The AI keeps replying normally.
Se quem administra a instalação desligou: If whoever administers the installation turned off spending protection (in Optional features › Behavior, in Admin), the card shows a yellow banner saying that the choice made here does not apply until it is turned back on.
Parte do limite já gasta: Share of the limit already spent
Fazer a IA parar no limite: Make the AI stop at the limit
Armar a parada da IA no limite do mês, e: Set up the AI stop at the month's limit, understand the 72-hour wait and know how to undo it.
A parada só pode ser ligada depois do av: The stop can only be turned on after the alert. This lesson starts with "Notify me" already saved, with a US$ 20.00 limit, as in the previous lesson. That way the alert is already in place when the stop takes effect. Click "Edit limit".
Agora \"Parar a IA ao chegar em US$ 20,0: Now "Stop the AI when it reaches US$ 20.00" is available. Select that option and read what it says: when the AI stops, ongoing conversations go to the human support queue. No one is left without a reply, but someone on the team needs to answer. Each conversation goes back to automatic through the "Return to automatic" button, in its header.
Ao marcar a parada, aparece uma faixa am: When you select the stop, a yellow banner appears: it only takes effect 72 hours after saving. That is the time for you to see the alert arrive before any conversation stops. If you need it to apply right away, select "Take effect now, without waiting the 72 hours". Here we leave it unchecked. Then click "Save".
O cartão agora diz quando a parada começ: The card now says when the stop takes effect: "The stop takes effect on", with the date and time, and "Until then, we'll just notify you." After that deadline, if the month's spending reaches the limit, the AI stops replying, a notice opens in the Notification Center and the card gets the red "AI stopped due to spend" badge. If spending goes over the limit and the AI is not stopped, the badge is "Went over the limit".
O sistema sempre avisa antes de parar. S: The system always alerts before stopping. If spending skips the alert point and goes straight to the limit, the first call only opens the alert; the AI stops from the next call on.
Para voltar atrás, clique em \"Editar li: To go back, click "Edit limit" and choose "Notify me" or "Just monitor". Loosening it applies right away, with no wait. When you save, the spending alerts that were open close on their own when you loosen the protection or when spending falls below the new alert point. Conversations that had already stopped do not come back on their own: each one comes back through the "Return to automatic" button, in the conversation's header.
Se quem administra a instalação deixou a: If whoever administers the installation left spending protection turned off or only alerting (in Optional features › Behavior, in Admin), the card shows a yellow banner saying that the stop chosen here does not apply.
Filtrar o uso por tipo, agente e período: Filter usage by type, agent and period
Ver quanto custou cada tipo de trabalho: See how much each type of AI work, each agent and each period cost.
Logo abaixo do cartão do orçamento ficam: Right below the budget card are four filters: "Agent", "Usage type", "From" and "To". They change the numbers and charts below. The "Monthly AI budget" card does not change: it always shows the current month. Start with "Usage type".
\"Tipo de uso\" separa o trabalho da IA: "Usage type" splits the AI's work by task. "Reply to the customer" is the reply the customer reads on WhatsApp. Other types are behind-the-scenes tasks, such as "Choose which agent handles it" or "Measure the conversation's mood". The list only shows the types that happened in the period. Choose "Reply to the customer".
O custo, as chamadas, a taxa de cache, o: The cost, the calls, the cache rate, the time and the cost, text and time charts now count only the calls of that type. That way you see how much the replies to the customer cost, separate from the behind-the-scenes work. Two cards do not change with the type: "Agent turns", which always counts the complete turns, with everything each one cost, and "Passed to a person". Now open the "Agent" filter.
\"Agente\" separa o uso de cada agente d: "Agent" separates the usage of each of the company's AI agents. "All" adds everything up. Choose "Bia — Virtual reception".
Agora a tela conta só as chamadas da Bia: Now the screen counts only Bia's calls, and only of the chosen type. Calls that were not linked to any agent are left out of the count. "Passed to a person" stays the same: it does not split by agent. The filters are kept in the page address: if you save the link, it opens with the same filters. To see everything again, choose "All" in "Agent" and "All" in "Usage type".
Para ver outro período, escolha as datas: To see another period, choose the dates in "From" and "To". With no dates, the screen shows the last 30 days. With only "From", it goes from that date until today. The screen shows at most 90 days at a time: for a longer period, it keeps the last 90 days of the period.
O texto embaixo do título continua dizen: The text below the title keeps saying "in the last 30 days" even with other dates chosen: what counts is the period in the filters. And the days follow the UTC clock; in Brasília time, the screen's day changes at 21:00.
A Agenda mostra os compromissos da clíni: The Calendar shows the clinic's appointments: consultations, sessions, and team meetings. Below "Appointments" are arrows to change weeks and view buttons. Next comes the appointment list, organized in tabs. Further down, the weekly grid begins; the next step shows all of it. At the top, "Google synchronization is not available yet" appears while the installation has no Google connection configured. The Calendar works normally without it; it just does not exchange appointments with Google Calendar.
Rolando a tela para baixo aparece a grad: Scrolling down shows the whole weekly grid. Each column is a day, from Sunday to Saturday, and each row is an hour, from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Each appointment is a colored block on the day and at the time it happens, in the color of the person attending: here, Wednesday's 5 p.m. team meeting is in Helena's color. Today's date appears inside a colored circle.
Na coluna de hoje, uma linha vermelha ma: In today's column, a red line marks the current time. It only appears while the current time fits in the grid, between 7 a.m. and 10 p.m.
Preencha o nome e pelo menos o e-mail ou: Enter the name and at least an email or phone number. Include the phone's area code; you do not need to type +55. In "Tags", pick the suggested tags or type one at a time and press Enter. If the color picker opens, check it and click "Add tag" to confirm. CPF is optional.
Na janela \"Editar contato\" você muda n: In "Edit contact", change the name, email, phone, and date of birth. To add a tag, type in the lower field and press Enter, or click a suggestion. If the color picker opens, confirm with "Add tag". Click a tag's X to remove it. Here we added "nutrition". Finally, click "Save".
